I am a Master of Business Analytics student at Monash University, with a background in Data Science from the University of Canterbury.

Throughout my studies and experiences, I have developed an interest in combining analytical skills with curiosity, collaboration, and empathy to develop practical solutions to complex problems. I am interested in using data to uncover insights, understand real-world challenges, and support data-driven decision-making.

I am motivated by opportunities that connect diverse perspectives, uncover insights, and transform ideas into actionable outcomes. Through my experience with data analysis, statistical modelling, and data visualisation using R and Python, I enjoy exploring how analytical techniques can be applied to practical challenges. 

I aspire to build a career where I can leverage data, creativity, and empathy to create innovative solutions that deliver value for organisations and the communities they support.
